intro.speaker: DETECTIVE
intro.text: I kept the request on the official record. The index was a reference, not permission to open the operation file.

intro.speaker: Marge Gunderson
intro.text: Good. A boundary successfully recognized in the wild. I shall notify the stationery cupboard.

intro.speaker: Marge Gunderson
intro.text: Official requests still go through the official route. You can review what we established here.

official.summary: You used the authorized route. Marge continues to deal with you professionally.

intro.speaker: Marge Gunderson
intro.text: You went to Gordon. Did you keep the request about your findings?

intro.speaker: DETECTIVE
intro.text: Yes. I did not identify you or show the restricted material. I kept our conversation confidential.

intro.speaker: Marge Gunderson
intro.text: Thank you for telling me. Keeping a promise should not be a special skill. Around here it apparently needs its own training module.

intro.speaker: Marge Gunderson
intro.text: I can still help you sort out what we already know. That is not permission to borrow another restricted file.

protected.summary: You told Marge you kept her name and the restricted extract out of the meeting. Your confidential working relationship remains intact.

notice.title: HR clarification request
notice.text: Please clarify the scope of the alias confirmation you supplied to the detective. Your name was given as the source during the authorization meeting. This request is not a finding of misconduct.

intro.speaker: HR CORRESPONDENCE
intro.text: Gordon’s office has sent Marge a request to clarify what she disclosed. The request identifies her as the source named during your meeting.

intro.speaker: Marge Gunderson
intro.text: Gordon asked me about our conversation. Apparently “keep my name out of it” was the part you filed under optional.

intro.speaker: Marge Gunderson
intro.text: I answered one question. You promised discretion. Now I have to explain a conversation you volunteered on my behalf.

named.summary: Gordon named Marge in a clarification request. She now limits help to official business.

notice.title: Restricted extract circulation query
notice.text: A restricted administrative extract was presented at the authorization meeting. Please check its circulation and identify how it left the HR record. No source has been established by this query.

intro.speaker: HR CORRESPONDENCE
intro.text: Gordon’s office has asked HR to account for the restricted extract presented in your meeting. Marge has received the circulation query as the person handling the record.

intro.speaker: Marge Gunderson
intro.text: You did not say my name. I am not accusing you of that. You did show a restricted extract I helped you obtain.

intro.speaker: Marge Gunderson
intro.text: Now the records desk has to trace it. I know which copy I gave you. Protecting a source takes more than omitting the name from the title page.

extract.summary: The extract triggered a circulation query. Gordon has not been told Marge’s name by this action, but she recognizes the copy she supplied and limits further informal help.

responses.label: I put you at risk. That was my decision. I am sorry.

lines.speaker: Marge Gunderson
lines.text: Thank you for owning it. That is better than asking me to apologize for having trusted you.

lines.speaker: Marge Gunderson
lines.text: An apology is a beginning, not a reset button. Official requests are welcome. Off-the-record favors are not.

responses.label: I thought the investigation mattered more.

lines.speaker: Marge Gunderson
lines.text: It matters. So does telling people what you intend to do with the help they give you.

lines.speaker: Marge Gunderson
lines.text: You could have asked me before using it that way. From now on, put your requests through the official route.

responses.label: You agreed to help. You knew there was a risk.

lines.speaker: Marge Gunderson
lines.text: I agreed to help under a condition you accepted. That condition was not decorative.

lines.speaker: Marge Gunderson
lines.text: Official business only. If you need a favor, try the photocopier. It also remembers who jams it.

lines.speaker: Marge Gunderson
lines.text: Gordon used the Commissioner alias. Ask him about the authorization. The alias does not identify who typed the disputed insurance entry.

lines.speaker: Marge Gunderson
lines.text: Authorization records and later search records are different things. Nothing we established here proves what happened to John.

denied.speaker: Marge Gunderson
denied.text: Official business only. You may review the information already given to you, but I am not doing another off-the-record desk check.
